item.title: Oregon father is the latest armed civilian to confront a gunman in a U.S. mass shooting
item.description:
A teacher threw her cellphone at a teenage gunman and tackled him during Thursday’s deadly shooting at an Oregon elementary school, fighting to wrestle away his shotgun before an armed father shot him dead, police revealed Friday . The 16-year-old gunman killed four people, including three children, at Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend, Oregon, where he had previously been a special needs student. All of the victims were in a special-needs classroom, school officials said. The teacher was not injured in the confrontation. Her heroic actions “almost certainly helped prevent more bloodshed,” Bend Police Chief Mike Krantz said during a news conference detailing the attack. The father, identified as Kaylub Giamanco , 36, has two children at the school. He witnessed the initial shooting outside and followed the gunman into the school, police said. item.title: Brazil: Amazon deforestation at 40-year low
item.description:
Forest clearance at smallest total since records began in 1988 in success for Lula ahead of presidential run-off Deforestation in the Brazilian Amazon has fallen to its lowest level since records began, new government data shows. But whether this globally important success is maintained or reversed is on a knife edge ahead of a presidential election run-off on 25 October between two candidates with sharply different visions for the future of the rainforest and how that affects relations with the US under Donald Trump.
